subject: Q2 launch readiness: owner alignment and QBR scenario planning
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alicia.park@nimbusapps.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 launch readiness: owner alignment and QBR scenario planning

Hi team,

With Q2 kickoff next week I want us to lock owners and decision rules for the launch OKRs so we can finalize the QBR packet. I attached a working spreadsheet (Q2_Launch_Readiness_v1.xlsx) with owner suggestions and a short checklist for three QBR scenarios (green / amber / red).

Asks:
- Please review the owner column and accept/reassign by EOD Monday (May 3).
- Add any blocking risks to the "Issues" tab and estimate mitigation ETA.
- Laura: can you confirm the exec readout time slot (15m or 30m) so we size the deck?
- Marissa & Steph: confirm the launch readiness gates and which metrics we want in the dashboard for the QBR (latency pctiles, cost/unit, rollout %).

I'm scheduling a 30-minute alignment on Tue 10am PT to adjudicate any disputes and turn these into action items. If you can't make it, leave notes in the sheet.

Attachment: Q2_Launch_Readiness_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Product Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alicia.park@nimbusapps.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 launch readiness: owner alignment and QBR scenario planning

Connor — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes inline below and a couple of edits I made in the sheet: 

> - Please review the owner column and accept/reassign by EOD Monday (May 3).
I accepted most owners but reassigned the "post-launch ops" owner to Marissa; Connor please confirm Marissa is comfortable owning the runbook.

> - Laura: can you confirm the exec readout time slot (15m or 30m) so we size the deck?
Recommend 20 minutes + 10 minutes for Q&A (30m total). We'll ask the CEO office for 30. If they push back we compress to 15 and drop the deep-dive slide.

Risks I flagged in the sheet:
- Model quantization regressions (probable) — mitigation: evaluate 2 quant profiles prior to canary, owner: aditya.
- Marketplace listing dependencies — blocker for some customers, owner: stephanie.

I can join Tue 10am but prefer Tue 9:30am if others can shift.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alicia.park@nimbusapps.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 launch readiness: owner alignment and QBR scenario planning

Connor / team — I'm good to own post-launch ops and have added a short runbook outline in the sheet (tab: Runbook). A few concrete asks from my side:

- For the QBR dashboard, let's include: 95th/99th latency, cost per 1k tokens, rollout % by cohort, and support ticket volume.
- I'll own the canary plan: propose 5% traffic to internal beta for first 24h, expand to 25% over 72h if no regressions.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-Deck — I'm dropping a draft slide that summarizes the canary gating.

Also looping in a short note for Alicia at Nimbus: any specific metrics they'd like to see? Alicia: could you confirm whether your legal/ops team needs a separate launch checklist for marketplace availability?

Marissa Cole
Sr. Launch Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alicia.park@nimbusapps.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 07:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 launch readiness: owner alignment and QBR scenario planning

Thanks — added a proposed QBR scoring rubric (attached: QBR_Scoring_Rubric_v2.pdf). Key suggestion: we present two scenarios in the exec packet — green (on-target) and amber (delayed/partial rollout) — with a one-slide remediation plan for amber.

Edits I made:
- Merged some overlapping risks under "infra" (network/capacity) and assigned a primary and secondary owner.
- Suggested we limit deep-dive metrics to three headline KPIs to keep the exec deck tight.

FYI forwarding a short note from Legal about marketplace timing:

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Legal Team <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 07:10:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace timing note
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com

We may need 2 weeks for contract review for marketplace listing; if that slips it becomes a launch dependency for several customers. Please flag in the exec readout if applicable.

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alicia.park@nimbusapps.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 launch readiness: owner alignment and QBR scenario planning — final sign-off

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary / decisions: 

1) Owners: Marissa confirmed for post-launch ops; Aditya is owner for quant profile evaluation; Stephanie primary for marketplace & infra coordination.
2) Exec slot: request 30 minutes (Laura to confirm with CEO office).
3) QBR packet: we'll present green + amber scenarios; Stephanie's rubric will become slide 3.
4) Canary plan: Marissa's 5% -> 25% cadence accepted; include a 24h rollback trigger (see sheet).
5) Action items before Tue alignment (Connor to track):
   - Aditya: quantify expected perf delta for two quant profiles (doc + numbers) — due Mon EOD.
   - Marissa: populate runbook and slide for canary gating — due Mon EOD.
   - Stephanie: consolidate infra risks and attach legal note — done (attached).

Meeting: Tue 10:00am PT (Connor will send calendar invite for the 30m slot; if Laura confirms 9:30, will update).

Attachments: Q2_Launch_Readiness_v1.xlsx, QBR_Scoring_Rubric_v2.pdf

Connor O'Brien
Product Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
